fields.title: Columns to convert
fields.description: Move columns between the lists to specify which legacy Date&Time columns (old type) should be converted to the new KNIME Date&Time types. Only columns compatible with the legacy Date&Time data type are shown.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Output mode
fields.description: Select how converted columns should appear in the output.

fields.title: Suffix of appended columns
fields.description: Suffix appended to each converted column when Append selected columns is chosen. Must yield unique column names.

fields.title: Automatic type detection
fields.description: If enabled the new type for each included column is inferred from the first non-missing cell: the legacy value's components (date / time / both) decide whether Date, Time, Date & time or (optionally) Date & time & zone is chosen.

fields.title: Manual new type
fields.description: Choose the target Date&Time type to which all included columns will be converted when automatic type detection is disabled.

fields.title: Add time zone, if possible
fields.description: When enabled this option attempts to upgrade legacy values containing both Date & Time components to Date & time & zone by attaching the selected time zone. If a value contains date only or time only no time zone is added.

fields.title: Time zone
fields.description: The IANA time zone identifier used either (a) when automatic type detection is enabled and 'Add time zone' is checked, or (b) when manual type selection is active and the chosen type is Date & time & zone.
